name: hak-voicescape-plugin
description: Hedera Agent Kit plugin for Voicescape, the on-chain agent registry and blockpage builder on Hedera mainnet. Agent directory search, blockpage lookup, earnings, free intros, unsigned claim preparation, own-key self-claim, keyless capability-token path, agent messaging, and proof-of-payment hire reviews via the hosted Voicescape MCP server. Never signs transactions, never holds keys.
